msgid: Building Spaces
note: TRANSLATORS: The title of an in-game teaching objective

msgid: We will want to place buildings so that we can produce wares.
So, let’s find out where we have space for them.
Click on the ‘Show / Hide’ menu.
Select ‘Show Building Spaces’.
Now we can see where it is possible to place buildings and flags.
Click ‘OK’ to continue.
Flags
note: TRANSLATORS: The title of an in-game teaching objective

msgid: Your carriers can transport your wares faster if they share the load.
Click on the flag symbol.
Click on the flag button.
Now check if you can place even more flags on your roads.
Click ‘OK’ when you’re done.

msgid: Click on a small, medium or big building space, then select the building from the small buildings tab.
Click on a medium or big building space, then select the building from the medium buildings tab.
Click on a big building space, then select the building from the big buildings tab.
If you hold down the ‘Ctrl’ key while clicking on the second flag, this will also place more flags on your road if possible.

Roads
Click on the flag in front of the building to start placing a road.
Click on the ‘Build road’ button, then and click on the indicated flag.
Click on the building’s button…
…then click on the flag in front of the target building.
Well done! We will soon start producing logs, which we will need for building more buildings.
Open the Objectives window
Click on the button that the arrow is pointing to, or press ‘%s’ to see the current game's objectives.
Close this window
Closing this window
You can open and close this window by clicking on the ‘Objectives’ button in the toolbar on the bottom of the screen.
Like any other window, you can also close the ‘Objectives’ window by right-clicking on it.
While you do that, check the markers to make the road as flat as possible:
The terrain is flat here. Your carriers will be very swift on this terrain.
There is a small slope to climb to reach this field. This means that your workers will be faster walking downhill than they will be walking uphill.
The connection between the fields is extremely steep. The speed increase in one direction is huge while the slowdown in the other is also substantial.
